name: Rhythm Dojo
summary:
**Ever tried drawing to the beat? Now try doing it in 360° VR!**

In Rhythm Dojo, glowing patterns appear all around you, from the floor to the ceiling and everywhere in between. Turn, reach, and trace them in time with the music!

**Feeling competitive?** Grab your controllers, master your precision, build combos, and fight for the top spot on the leaderboards.
